items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Josephine was only 17 years old when she died. She came to Chicago to see my mother. And that was the first time I had seen her since she was a little tiny girl.

ctx.x: Whatever happened to Josephine, your sister?
Josephine? Well, Josephine was only 17 years old when she died. She came to Chicago to see my mother. And that was the first time I had seen her since she was a little tiny girl.
